slots.notes: Optional brand logo/monogram inside the circular brand mark; currently CSS-drawn as a zig-zag clip-path wave (no asset). A brand would swap in a 1:1 transparent mono-color SVG that tints to fg over the white-circle ground.

mechanic: Black monolithic footer: a 200%-wide triple radial-gradient dot band drifts left on an infinite linear keyframe above a clamp-fluid nav grid, an oversized live-text wordmark with a CSS clip-path zig-zag brand mark, and a legal line.
techDelivery: plain CSS + HTML component spec (semantic markup, CSS custom property --hero-max-width, radial-gradient + clip-path + @keyframes; no JS, no framework)
reskinNotes: Brand mark is a hardcoded clip-path polygon zig-zag (geometry baked in, not an asset) over a white circle — reskinning to a real logo means replacing the ::before. Every color is baked inline as literal hex/rgba (no CSS variables for color). All copy (headline, nav labels + hrefs, wordmark, copyright, legal links) is hardcoded in markup. Wordmark layout is font-metric-dependent: letter-spacing -0.055em + line-height 0.78 + white-space:nowrap at font-size 11.1vw is tuned to "EngineTech" and will overflow/clip for longer brand names. Font stack hard-codes Geist/Inter.
